svg.text: CONVERTER 80 bar g IN; V-201 75 bar g / 40 C; FEED 1928 kNm3/h;
MAKE-UP 366 kNm3/h; PURGE 105 kNm3/h; MeOH 112.5 t/h; Q(RXN) 85 MW.
1. SEE MEOH-PID-001 NOTES 1-2 FOR DESIGN BASIS, LINE SIZING AND SERVICE CODES. LOOP GAS AT C-201 SUCTION: H2 81.6 / CH4 11.5 / CO2 2.5 / CO 2.3 / N2 1.7 / CH3OH 0.36 mol % (OTS MODEL).

2. MAKE-UP SYNGAS (BATTERY LIMIT): H2 73 / CO 16 / CO2 7 / CH4 3.3 / N2 0.5 / H2O 0.2 mol % (ASSUMED, TBC); FIC-202 SETS THE PLANT RATE; XV-202 FAILS CLOSED AND IS THE SIS FINAL ELEMENT FOR I-1...I-5.
3. PIC-203 HOLDS THE LOOP PRESSURE WITH THE PURGE (PV-203): A LESS ACTIVE CONVERTER OR A HOTTER SEPARATOR RAISES THE LOOP PRESSURE AND THE PURGE - THE PURGE RATE IS THE BEST CONVERTER HEALTH SIGNAL.
4. C-201: VARIABLE-SPEED MOTOR DRIVE; FIC-201 TRIMS SPEED. FSLL-201 (I-2) AND LSHH-204 (I-3, ALSO STOPS C-201 TO PROTECT IT FROM LIQUID CARRY-OVER). SEAL/LUBE SYSTEMS PER VENDOR.
5. E-203: COOLING WATER 32 C SUPPLY; V-201 AT 40 C CONDENSES CRUDE METHANOL (~85 wt % CH3OH); HIGHER SEPARATOR TEMPERATURE RECYCLES MORE CH3OH AND LOWERS CONVERTER DRIVING FORCE.
6. PSV-201 SET 88 bar g PROTECTS THE WHOLE LOOP (BLOCKED-OUTLET CASE AT MAX MAKE-UP - SIZING TBC). HV-205 MANUAL BLOWDOWN TO FLARE FOR EMERGENCY DEPRESSURING (RESTRICTION ORIFICE TBC).
CHULA CHEM. ENG. - METHANOL CONVERTER VER 1 (OTS)
